UPDATE forge_jobs
            SET
                status = 'pending',
                worker_id = NULL,
                claimed_at = NULL,
                started_at = NULL,
                last_heartbeat = NULL
            WHERE
                (
                    status = 'claimed'
                    AND claimed_at < NOW() - make_interval(secs => $1)
                )
                OR (
                    status = 'running'
                    AND COALESCE(last_heartbeat, started_at, claimed_at) < NOW() - make_interval(secs => $1)
                )
